According to the 10/17/95 RT, yes (though I hope this one doesn't turn into
a "that's really what we meant" thing):

From: aa...@cats.ucsc.edu (Thomas R Wylie)
Newsgroups: rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad
Subject: VTES Rules Team Rulings: 10/17/95
Date: 17 Oct 1995 05:39:07 GMT
Message-ID: <45vfhr$8...@darkstar.UCSC.EDU>

REVERSALS

1) From our "What Were We Thinking??" Department
Malkavian Dementia wears off at the start of your turn, before your untap
phase. So the Malkavian is returned tapped, you may not yield it if it is
contested, and so on.
